descriptor: Markdown editor for short, honest writing

voice.summary: Fieldnote sounds like a good editor with a pencil: brief, kind and allergic to padding. It talks about writing as small, useful notes and keeps its own instructions equally short.
dos: Use verbs that match the toolbar: bold, link, copy
Show shortcuts in the same sentence as the action
donts: Do not use writing-guru phrases like 'unleash your creativity'
Never alter the user's text without saying so

boilerplate: Fieldnote is a split-pane Markdown editor with live preview, keyboard shortcuts, word count and one-click HTML export, built for people who write short and often.

microcopy.error: Could not copy. Select the preview and try again.
microcopy.empty: Nothing written yet. Start typing on the left.

logo.note: An open book suits an editor devoted to notes, drafts and tidy writing.
